newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Rouble stable, trade calm on U.S. holiday.
newsitem.headline: Rouble stable, trade calm on U.S. holiday.

text.p: The rouble was little changed in quiet trading on Thursday, with the U.S. Thanksgiving Day holiday being the main reason for subdued activity, dealers said.
Russian banks use U.S. banks for settlement and no deals for today settlement were struck.
roubles/dollar Nov 28 midday Nov 28 early Nov 27 close
"Today is a day-off for banks. There is no day-to-day trading and everything is quiet," Promradtekhbank dealer Yaroslav Melikhov said and added only client orders were seen on the market.
Vozrozhdenye Bank dealer Alexei Vorobyov said the rouble was stable at the lower limit of the central bank's rates and fluctuations were not higher than 0.5-1.0 point.
